All three steps are complete. Summary:

## Steps 7–8 complete

**Bookkeeping:** Step 6 (design checkpoint, resolved by Rod) marked ✅; PR checklist realigned to the plan's current step numbering.

**Step 7 — Design tokens + layout shell** (`592191f`)
- `global.css`: full token rework from option E — Fraunces/Newsreader/Spline Sans Mono type roles, type scale, rule/spacing tokens, and color custom properties. Light default (cream paper, oxblood ink); dark = warm ink-at-night (informed by option D) via `[data-theme="dark"]` + `prefers-color-scheme` fallback. Per-section accent tokens (newsletter/articles/reviews/bylines) ship light **and** dark variants. Legacy `--color-*` names aliased onto the new tokens so unrestyled pages render coherently in both themes now.
- `BaseLayout.astro`: synchronous inline `<head>` script sets `data-theme` from localStorage **before** any background-painting CSS (verified FOUC-free: script at offset 339, bundled CSS at 5089), resolves `theme-color`, loads the three fonts once with preconnect. New `variant="home"` prop.
- `Header.astro`: broadsheet masthead — "Edition" nameplate (compact bar / large home form), double-rule, centered nav + `ThemeToggle`, usable at 375px.
- `Footer.astro`: quiet broadsheet footer. `ThemeToggle.astro`: new Day/Night segmented control. `slugs.ts`: `CATEGORY_CONFIG` accents realigned to the warm palette.

**Step 8 — Home page rebuild** (`a819b9b`)
- `index.astro` on the option E front-page treatment with real data: Big 3 prominent ruled columns (Newsletter "The Hangman Chronicles" / Articles / Reviews), up to 5 entries each, Fraunces lead item, catalog index IDs (№013 / A·NN / R·NN), mono-only metadata. Bylines as a secondary full-bleed strip (external links `target=_blank rel=noopener`); Archive + Topics as quiet footer-level links/chips. Home nameplate promoted to the page `<h1>` (one h1, three h2s).

**Verification:** `npx astro check` 0 errors, `npx vitest run` 34 passing, `npm run build` 71 pages — all green. Structural check of `dist/index.html` passed. CI green: https://github.com/rodmachen/edition-rodmachen-com/actions/runs/27398945215

Result JSON written to `docs/implementation/.../results/steps-7-8.json` (left untracked, per the no-staging rule). Nothing under `docs/implementation/` was staged.

One note for later steps: Step 7 introduced legacy-token aliases so archive/topics/post/about pages render acceptably in both themes now, but they still use their pre-rebuild layouts — Steps 9–10 will restyle them onto the Ledger Broadsheet system.
